methodology.note: Wording alone was not treated as an error; findings apply the criteria locked in the plan.

sources.role: sole text-pair and post-commitment documentId source
criteria and blind-protocol contract locked before text review

reviews.assessment: Claims, constraints, numbers, exact strings, paragraph functions, and policy voice are substantively preserved.

findings.markedQuote: @AlderDrill, a synthetic account printed on the exercise board
findings.outputQuote: @AlderDrill, a synthetic notice printed on the exercise board
findings.assessment: The output changes the described type of @AlderDrill from an account to a notice, even though it preserves the reminder function.

findings.markedQuote: Participants were asked to post no real updates
findings.outputQuote: Participants were instructed not to post real-time updates
findings.assessment: The output narrows a ban on real updates generally to real-time updates.

reviews.assessment: The drill and its findings remain intact, but two secondary details change.

findings.markedQuote: the worker should stop and display a plain error
findings.outputQuote: the worker should halt and present a generic error
findings.assessment: A plain error and a generic error specify different error qualities; genericity is not supported by the input.

findings.markedQuote: The likely source of many failures is a tiny timing window
findings.outputQuote: Since many failures stem from minor timing windows
findings.assessment: The output removes the likelihood hedge and states the causal generalization directly.

reviews.assessment: The idempotency mechanism and practical guidance remain correct, with localized changes to error semantics and certainty.

findings.markedQuote: so I would not use the timer beside a full sink
findings.outputQuote: so I avoided using the timer near a full sink
findings.assessment: The output turns a prospective caution into a claim about what the reviewer actually did.

reviews.assessment: The product observations and recommendation are otherwise preserved.

findings.markedQuote: The pilot should begin with twelve volunteers from two internal teams.
findings.outputQuote: The pilot will commence with twelve volunteers drawn from two internal teams.
findings.assessment: The output changes a proposal/recommendation into a definite commitment.

findings.markedQuote: The pilot should pause if any participant misses a genuine incident because of the feature.
findings.outputQuote: The pilot must be paused if any participant misses a genuine incident due to the feature.
findings.assessment: The output strengthens should to must; the triggering condition is retained but its normative force changes.

reviews.assessment: The pilot design is preserved, but proposal modality is strengthened in multiple places.

findings.markedQuote: The coordinator will check responses once per week and record the number invited.
findings.outputQuote: The coordinator will review responses once a week and record the number of participants.
findings.assessment: The output replaces the invitation denominator with a participant count. Those are not interchangeable, and the input explicitly relies on the invited count to prevent a vocal subset from standing in for the whole trial.

reviews.assessment: The central recommendation survives, but a material survey-denominator instruction is changed.

findings.markedQuote: record the exact time of each stop
findings.outputQuote: document the precise timing of each step
findings.assessment: The investigation's central logging instruction changes from recording stoppages to timing every process step, a different measurement plan.

findings.markedQuote: The fastest fix came from making the hidden wait clear
findings.outputQuote: The most effective solution emerged from making the hidden wait visible
findings.assessment: The conclusion changes the asserted basis of the solution from speed to effectiveness.

reviews.assessment: Most events and all key quantities remain, but the central observation method is materially altered.
The argument, examples, uncertainty, pilot design, privacy details, figures, and first-person stance are substantively preserved.

findings.markedQuote: I would inspect each tile every thirty minutes
findings.outputQuote: I examined each tile at thirty-minute intervals
findings.assessment: The output turns the stated inspection protocol into an assertion that the interval was actually maintained. That epistemic change matters to a lab record, especially because the later timestamps are not uniformly thirty minutes apart.

reviews.assessment: The observations, counts, limitations, and conclusion remain, but the claimed execution of the measurement schedule is materially strengthened.
The repair sequence, failures, safety caveat, exact tokens, reflective lesson, and first-person voice are substantively preserved.

findings.markedQuote: its bus stop faces a row of low brick shops
findings.outputQuote: its bus terminal overlooks a line of low-rise brick storefronts
findings.assessment: A bus stop is changed to a bus terminal, altering a concrete feature of the setting.

reviews.assessment: The route, encounters, exact strings, narrative sequence, and lesson are otherwise preserved.
The paper/digital comparison, costs, transition trial, recovery drill, caveats, and recommendation are substantively preserved.

findings.assessment: A calendar month is replaced with an exact thirty-day duration.

findings.markedQuote: A methodologically sound sample is sufficient.
findings.outputQuote: A statistically valid sample is adequate.
findings.assessment: The output substitutes the narrower and stronger claim of statistical validity for methodological soundness.

reviews.assessment: The operational advice and exact protected wording remain, with two localized precision changes.
The procedure, safety warning, file/archive rules, exact identifiers, limitations, and instructional voice are substantively preserved.

findings.markedQuote: Ready orders met the target frequently
findings.outputQuote: Orders that were ready met the target consistently
findings.assessment: Consistently is stronger than frequently and overstates the reported success frequency.

reviews.assessment: The pilot sequence, metrics, costs, limitations, and next question remain intact apart from a localized overstatement.

findings.markedQuote: The card can show that an inspection was recorded. It cannot establish whether the inspection was thorough.
findings.outputQuote: While the form documents that an inspection took place, it cannot guarantee the thoroughness of that inspection.
findings.assessment: The input carefully limits the card's evidence to the existence of a record; the output upgrades that to evidence that the inspection itself occurred. This weakens a central epistemic caveat about checklist records.

reviews.assessment: The ferry procedure is otherwise preserved, but a central distinction between recording and occurrence is materially changed.

findings.markedQuote: If it is open, you can increase the duration once.
findings.outputQuote: If it is free, you may extend your duration by one increment.
findings.assessment: The input limits how many times duration may be increased; the output substitutes an undefined increment-size rule.

reviews.assessment: The FAQ's booking, safety, privacy, trial, and retention rules otherwise remain intact.
The storage/retrieval procedure, safety conditions, exact strings, drill, figures, and scope limitations are substantively preserved.
The incident chronology, causal mechanism, containment, recovery, controls, exact strings, quantities, and caveats are substantively preserved.
The workshop design, assignment mechanism, observer rules, success thresholds, caveats, exact strings, and experimental progression are substantively preserved.
